name: lightweight-integration-for-indexnow
description: Local WordPress development and plugin verification tooling.

scripts.env:start: npm run test:package && node scripts/wp-env.cjs start && node scripts/wp-env.cjs --config .wp-env.tests.json start
scripts.env:stop: node scripts/wp-env.cjs stop && node scripts/wp-env.cjs --config .wp-env.tests.json stop
scripts.env:status: node scripts/wp-env.cjs status && node scripts/wp-env.cjs --config .wp-env.tests.json status
scripts.test:integration: npm run test:package && node scripts/wp-env.cjs --config .wp-env.tests.json run cli wp eval-file wp-content/indexnow-tests/integration.php
scripts.test:minimum: node scripts/wp-env.cjs --config .wp-env.minimum.json start && node scripts/wp-env.cjs --config .wp-env.minimum.json run cli wp eval-file wp-content/plugins/lightweight-integration-for-indexnow/tests/integration.php
scripts.test: npm run test:package && npm run test:integration && npm run test:plugin-check
